record.body:
## Description

Teach execute-phase to run each wave inline or as subagents, following the recipe already on the task.

## Approach

Edit `skills/execute-phase/SKILL.md`. When dispatching a wave, read `payload.executor` on each ready task. Missing or empty means `subagent`. If the tasks in the wave disagree, stop and name them. Do not spawn anything.

`subagent` keeps the current dispatch: one `generalPurpose` subagent per task, in parallel within the wave. `inline` does not spawn a subagent. This session implements the task, then still writes the execution-report and runs verify-work.

The brief already carries the work-item body. The skill must say to follow `## Approach` and not ask the user for an implementation recipe when that section is present. The parent remains the only writer.

Add `tests/test_execute_wave_dispatch.py` asserting those rules in the skill text.

Do not edit `skills/plan-phase/SKILL.md`, the contract, `README.md`, or `tests/test_plan_wave_rules.py`.

payload.title: Dispatch each wave inline or as subagents
